dict.string: StrikeLabCaddie tracks your golf rounds as workouts.
StrikeLabCaddie saves your golf rounds and heart rate data during play.
StrikeLabCaddie uses motion sensors to detect golf swings for automatic shot logging.
StrikeLabCaddie uses your location on the watch to recognise when you arrive at a course you've saved, so you can start a round in one tap.
StrikeLabCaddie listens for the click of club impact to time your swing more precisely. You can turn this off in Settings. Impact audio is stored only for your swing review and is not uploaded.
